meetings.title: Initial Discovery Call
meetings.agenda: Understanding client requirements and pain points
meetings.transcript: Client discussed their current challenges with legacy systems and need for modernization. They're looking for a scalable solution that can handle 10x growth. Budget approval process takes 3-6 months.
meetings.action_items: Send technical architecture proposal, Schedule follow-up with procurement team

meetings.title: Technical Deep Dive
meetings.transcript: Discussed API integration requirements, security compliance needs (SOC2), and deployment preferences. They prefer cloud-native solutions with Kubernetes.
meetings.action_items: Provide security compliance documentation, Create integration timeline

meetings.title: Executive Stakeholder Meeting
meetings.agenda: High-level business case and ROI discussion
meetings.transcript: Executive team expressed strong interest in digital transformation initiative. CFO emphasized need for clear ROI metrics and cost savings projections. CEO wants to see competitive advantages and market positioning benefits. Timeline pressure due to Q4 budget cycle.
meetings.action_items: Prepare detailed ROI analysis, Create executive summary presentation, Schedule demo with key stakeholders

meetings.title: Security and Compliance Review
meetings.transcript: Security team raised concerns about data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and industry-specific compliance (HIPAA). Need for end-to-end encryption, audit trails, and regular security assessments. Legal team wants to review data processing agreements and liability clauses.
meetings.action_items: Submit security architecture review, Provide compliance documentation, Schedule legal review meeting

meetings.title: Implementation Planning Session
meetings.agenda: Project timeline, resource allocation, and implementation strategy
meetings.transcript: Project team discussed phased implementation approach with MVP in 6 months and full deployment in 12 months. Need for dedicated project team of 8-10 people. Infrastructure team prefers gradual migration to minimize business disruption. Training and change management are critical success factors.
meetings.action_items: Create detailed project plan, Define team structure and roles, Prepare change management strategy

meetings.title: Vendor Comparison Meeting
meetings.transcript: Procurement team is evaluating 3 vendors including us. Key differentiators needed: cost-effectiveness, implementation speed, and ongoing support quality. They have concerns about vendor lock-in and want to see migration strategies. Decision timeline is 4 weeks.
meetings.action_items: Submit competitive analysis, Provide migration strategy document, Schedule reference customer calls

questionnaire.question: What is your primary business objective for this project?
questionnaire.answer: Modernize our legacy systems to improve scalability and reduce maintenance costs

questionnaire.question: What is your expected timeline for implementation?
questionnaire.answer: We need to start implementation within 3 months and complete within 12 months

questionnaire.question: What is your budget range for this project?
questionnaire.answer: We have allocated $500K - $1M for this initiative

questionnaire.question: What are your biggest technical challenges currently?
questionnaire.answer: Our legacy systems can't handle the current load, causing frequent downtime and poor user experience. We also struggle with data integration between different systems.

questionnaire.question: What security and compliance requirements do you have?
questionnaire.answer: We need SOC2 Type II compliance, GDPR compliance for EU customers, and HIPAA compliance for healthcare data. We also require end-to-end encryption and regular security audits.

questionnaire.question: How many users will be using the system?
questionnaire.answer: Currently we have 2,500 active users, but we expect to grow to 25,000 users within the next 2 years. We need a solution that can scale automatically.

questionnaire.question: What is your current technology stack?
questionnaire.answer: We're using Java Spring Boot for backend, React for frontend, PostgreSQL for database, and AWS for hosting. We want to maintain compatibility with our existing stack while modernizing the architecture.

questionnaire.question: What are your performance requirements?
questionnaire.answer: We need 99.9% uptime, response times under 200ms for API calls, and ability to handle 10,000 concurrent users. We also need real-time data processing capabilities.

questionnaire.question: Who are the key decision makers for this project?
questionnaire.answer: The CEO, CFO, CTO, and Head of Engineering are the primary decision makers. The procurement team will handle vendor evaluation, and legal will review contracts.

questionnaire.question: What is your preferred deployment model?
questionnaire.answer: We prefer cloud-native solutions with Kubernetes orchestration. We want both on-premises and cloud deployment options for hybrid scenarios.

questionnaire.question: What training and support do you need?
questionnaire.answer: We need comprehensive training for our development team, documentation, and 24/7 support during the first year. We also want a dedicated customer success manager.

questionnaire.question: What are your integration requirements?
questionnaire.answer: We need to integrate with Salesforce, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and our existing ERP system. We also need REST APIs and webhook capabilities for real-time data sync.

questionnaire.question: What is your risk tolerance for this project?
questionnaire.answer: We have low risk tolerance due to business criticality. We need a proven solution with minimal downtime during migration and comprehensive rollback capabilities.

questionnaire.question: How do you measure success for this project?
questionnaire.answer: Success metrics include 50% reduction in maintenance costs, 99.9% uptime, 3x faster development cycles, and 90% user satisfaction scores.

questionnaire.question: What are your data backup and disaster recovery requirements?
questionnaire.answer: We need automated daily backups, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery with RTO of 4 hours and RPO of 1 hour. Data should be replicated across multiple regions.
